title: DatePicker
description: To select or input a date.
whenToUse: By clicking the input box, you can select a date from a popup calendar.

examples.name: Basic
examples.description: Basic use case. Users can select or input a date in a panel.

examples.name: Range Picker
examples.description: Set range picker type by `picker` prop.

examples.name: Multiple
examples.description: Multiple selections. Does not support `showTime` and `picker="time"`.

examples.name: Need Confirm
examples.description: DatePicker will automatically determine whether to show a confirm button according to the `picker` property. You can also set the `needConfirm` property to determine whether to show a confirm button. When `needConfirm` is set, the user must click the confirm button to complete the selection. Otherwise, the selection will be submitted when the picker loses focus or selects a date.

examples.name: Switchable picker
examples.description: Switch in different types of pickers by Select.

examples.name: Date Format
examples.description: We can set the date format by `format`. When `format` is an array, the input box can be entered in any of the valid formats of the array.

examples.name: Choose Time
examples.description: This property provides an additional time selection. When `showTime` is an Object, its properties will be passed on to the built-in `TimePicker`.

examples.name: Mask Format
examples.description: Align the date format. Switch the selection by arrow keys. Will try to align the date to the last valid date when blur.

examples.name: Limit Date Range
examples.description: Limit the range of available dates by using `minDate` and `maxDate`.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled state of the `DatePicker`. You can also set as array to disable one of input.

examples.name: Disabled Date & Time
examples.description: Disable specific dates and times by using `disabledDate` and `disabledTime` respectively, and `disabledTime` only works with `showTime`.

examples.name: Allow Empty
examples.description: Allow empty for the RangePicker. It's useful when you need to keep the "to date".

examples.name: Select range dates
examples.description: Using `info.from` of `disabledDate` to limit the dynamic date range selection.

examples.name: Preset Ranges
examples.description: We can set preset ranges to RangePicker to improve user experience. Since `5.8.0`, preset value supports callback function.

examples.name: Extra Footer
examples.description: Render extra footer in panel for customized requirements.

examples.name: Three Sizes
examples.description: The input box comes in three sizes: small, medium and large. The `medium` size will be used if `size` is omitted.

examples.name: Customized Cell Rendering
examples.description: We can customize the rendering of the cells in the calendar by providing a `cellRender` function to `DatePicker`.

examples.name: Customize Panel
examples.description: Replace panel with `components`.

examples.name: External use panel
examples.description: Custom menu, external selection panel.

examples.name: Buddhist Era
examples.description: Use `locale` to support special calendar format.

examples.name: Status
examples.description: Add status to DatePicker with `status`, which could be `error` or `warning`.

examples.name: Variants
examples.description: Variants of DatePicker, there are four variants: `outlined` `filled` `borderless` and `underlined`.
examples.code:
import React from 'react';
import { DatePicker, Flex } from 'antd';

const { RangePicker } = DatePicker;

const App: React.FC = () => (
  <Flex vertical gap={12}>
    <Flex gap={8}>
      <DatePicker placeholder="Outlined" />
      <RangePicker placeholder={['Outlined Start', 'Outlined End']} />
    </Flex>
    <Flex gap={8}>
      <DatePicker placeholder="Filled" variant="filled" />
      <RangePicker placeholder={['Filled Start', 'Filled End']} variant="filled" />
    </Flex>
    <Flex gap={8}>
      <DatePicker placeholder="Borderless" variant="borderless" />
      <RangePicker placeholder={['Borderless Start', 'Borderless End']} variant="borderless" />
    </Flex>
    <Flex gap={8}>
      <DatePicker placeholder="Underlined" variant="underlined" />
      <RangePicker placeholder={['Underlined Start', 'Underlined End']} variant="underlined" />
    </Flex>
  </Flex>
);

export default App;

  • root
    根元素，包含相对定位、行内flex布局、内边距、边框圆角、过渡动画等日期选择器容器的基础样式
  • prefix
    前缀元素，包含flex布局、右外边距等前缀内容的布局样式
  • input
    输入框元素，包含相对定位、宽度、颜色、字体、行高、过渡动画等输入框的核心交互样式
  • suffix
    后缀元素，包含flex布局、颜色、行高、指针事件、过渡动画等后缀内容的样式
  • popup.root
    弹出框元素
  • popup.container
    容器元素，设置背景色、内边距、圆角、阴影、边框和内容展示样式
  • popup.header
    弹出框头部元素，包含导航按钮、月份年份选择器等头部控制区域的布局和样式
  • popup.body
    弹出框主体元素，包含日期面板表格的容器布局和样式
  • popup.content
    弹出框内容元素，包含日期表格的宽度、边框、单元格等内容展示样式
  • popup.item
    弹出框单项元素，包含日期单元格的尺寸、背景色、边框圆角、悬停态、选中态等交互样式
  • popup.footer
    弹出框底部元素，包含确认取消按钮、快捷选择等底部操作区域的布局样式
